mapper.sql: id, category_id, attr_id, group_name, sort, required, options, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product_category_attribute_relation WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY group_name, sort

SELECT r.id, r.category_id, r.attr_id, r.group_name, r.sort, r.required, r.options, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM product_category_attribute_relation r INNER JOIN product_attribute a ON r.attr_id = a.id WHERE r.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.type = #{type} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.group_name, r.sort
SELECT a.id FROM product_attribute a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.id NOT IN ( SELECT attr_id FROM product_category_attribute_relation WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ) ORDER BY a.type, a.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO product_category_attribute_relation ( category_id, attr_id, group_name, sort, required, options, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
(#{item.categoryId}, #{item.attrId}, #{item.groupName}, #{item.sort}, #{item.required}, #{item.options}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_category_attribute_relation WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND attr_id = #{attrId}

DELETE FROM product_category_attribute_relation WHERE attr_id IN
#{attrId}

update.foreach: UPDATE product_category_attribute_relation SET group_name = #{item.groupName}, sort = #{item.sort}, required = #{item.required}, options = #{item.options}, update_time = NOW() WHERE category_id = #{item.categoryId} AND attr_id = #{item.attrId}
